**Finding: missing** (INSURANCE — Vendor insurance)

- **Investigation:** A literal search for "insurance" returned zero paragraphs, and the section outline has no insurance heading. The nearest neighbours flagged by the planner (§ 5.3 Security, § 14.12 Risk of Loss) address security features and allocation of risk of loss for Base/Customer Components only — neither imposes any coverage obligation.
- **Why it matters:** § 5.3 confirms IBM operates the e-business Hosting Environment and holds Customer Components, i.e. a hosting vendor processing our data. Under the playbook, no insurance at all for such a vendor is walk-away territory, so this is a genuine missing-clause finding rather than a minor sub-element.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** New § 14.12A "Insurance" inserted after § 14.12 in the miscellaneous section, at the preferred position — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request, maintained through the term plus one year. The comment offers the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback to keep the negotiation efficient.
